properties.name: kolbasa.cluster.schema.startup-attempts
properties.description: How many times to try the schema of the cluster queues at startup, at least 1. If the last try fails too, the application does not start.

properties.name: kolbasa.cluster.schema.startup-retry-delay
properties.description: The pause before every next try of the schema of the cluster queues at startup, see kolbasa.cluster.schema.startup-attempts. 0 means no pause.

properties.name: kolbasa.standalone.schema.enabled
properties.description: Whether to create or update the tables of the standalone queues at startup. Switch it off when someone else manages the schema, a DBA or Flyway.

properties.name: kolbasa.workers.auto-startup
properties.description: Whether to start the QueueWorker beans once the application is up. Switch it off to keep them stopped, for example in tests.
